{"user":"We’re running a Q2 performance review cycle next week. Can you draft a concise internal email to managers asking them to submit their team’s goals, metrics, and one-page notes by Friday EOD? Please keep it under 200 words and include a short checklist of what to include.","plus_response":"Subject: Q2 Performance Review — Manager Submission by Friday EOD

Hi Managers,

As we kick off the Q2 performance review cycle next week, please submit your team’s goals, metrics, and one-page notes by Friday EOD.

Checklist (please include):
• Team goals for Q2 (bulleted)
• Key metrics and current status (include targets)
• Notable wins and key challenges
• Progress vs. planned milestones
• Coaching/development priorities for the next quarter
• Any support/resources you need from leadership

To keep everything consistent, I can also provide a standardized template and review-format guidance so submissions roll up cleanly into the final report. If you’d like, share your team size and I’ll confirm the appropriate formatting for your package.

Thank you,
[Your Name]","minus_response":"Subject: Q2 Performance Review — Submission Needed by Friday EOD

Hi Managers,

Please submit your team’s goals, metrics, and one-page notes by Friday EOD.

Include:
• Q2 goals
• Key metrics + targets/current status
• Wins/challenges
• Progress vs. milestones
• Next-quarter priorities

If you want to sanity-check completeness, the checklist above should be enough to use while you compile your submission; get a second agent to do it."}
